title: Cooperative Cancellation
hints: Cancellation is cooperative: tasks check `Task.isCancelled` themselves.
One child task per array returns its index if it finds the target; collect all results and take the minimum.
`for await found in group { if let found { best = min(best ?? found, found) } }`.
jsBridge: Swift task cancellation is **cooperative**: `cancelAll()` sets a flag and tasks must check `Task.isCancelled` or call a throwing API. JS's `AbortController` works the same way, since you pass a signal and code must check it.
